info.title: ExhibitOS Artist CMS API
info.description: Authenticated private tenant CMS. Artist/admin manage owned resources; assigned curator display projection uses existing resource policy. No anonymous publication. Full display profile/rights checks required before immutable artwork approval. Cookie OR alternatives; mutations require CSRF plus exact Origin/Host. Archive/restore is reversible and retains objects/revisions. PNG and static identity-node, no-morph/skin/animation GLB display derivatives are qualified; original geometry is still copyable and no DRM is promised. New APIs are additive; legacy metadata must be converted to the strict CMS schema before approval. CMS-managed artworks retain a persistent marker: legacy generic artwork PATCH returns CMS_ROUTE_REQUIRED and full private metadata GET is owner/admin-only. Original download/export requires both current artwork rights and asset rights; malformed/missing CMS rights fail closed. Legacy artworks without the CMS marker retain prior policy until explicit CMS conversion.

get.summary: Read watermarked display derivative, never original fallback

parameters.name: expectedRevision
parameters.description: Optional exact current approved artwork revision. Studio passes its immutable snapshot revision. Checked together with current authorization and artwork/asset display rights before any bytes under the same request transaction; mismatch returns REVISION_CONFLICT (409). Omission preserves legacy current-preview behavior.

X-ExhibitOS-Artwork-Revision.description: Exact approved artwork revision of these derivative bytes.

localSession.name: exhibitos_local_session
localSession.description: Local loopback HTTP only; HttpOnly SameSite=Strict Path=/.

networkSession.name: __Host-exhibitos_session
networkSession.description: HTTPS host-only Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict Path=/. Network listener remains loopback behind an external TLS terminator.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Synchronizer token obtained from authenticated session; required with session cookie for authenticated mutations.

Rights.description: Copied without property changes from the pinned public @exhibitos/spec OES rights schema. Strict UTC calendar and validFrom/expiresAt ordering are additionally validated by the server. Rights validity is rechecked at access time.
